title: Root-free scatteredness criterion for the explicit four-coordinate finite-field family in the small-Frobenius-exponent regime
author: Bartoli, Daniele; Marino, Giuseppe; Neri, Alessandro; Vicino, Lara
difficulty_reason: The sufficiency argument eliminates scalar intersections through a Frobenius polynomial and proves exceptionality across infinitely many field extensions. The necessity argument constructs a Kummer curve from a root, computes its genus and excludes boundary places to force a forbidden finite-field intersection by Hasse–Weil. Both directions are one restricted criterion, not separate variants.
